artworks.title: Noah Leaving the Ark
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30.4 × 38.4 cm (11 15/16 × 15 1/8 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of animals disembarking from an ark. Animals including pairs of goats, lions, and various creatures are moving down a ramp from a large boat-like structure. Birds are in the background flying overhead or perched. Several figures are near the ramp, observing the animals. The drawing is detailed, depicting a variety of animal life with attention to textures and forms, creating a dynamic scene.

artworks.title: A Wide Riverscape with a View of Heidelberg Castle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with mountains in the distance and various buildings on hills and slopes. The intricate etching features detailed natural terrain, buildings, a river, boats, and a village. The monochrome color palette adds depth and detail to the scene.

artworks.title: Het Sluisje te Edam (The Little Sluice, Edam)
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown-black on wove paper [artist's proof]
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with a tranquil setting. From an elevated angle, the village includes small houses with pointed roofs, a row of trees, and a wooden bridge. In the sky, a line of birds flies above the houses. Near the viewer, there is a peaceful waterway reflecting the village buildings, featuring windows, doors, and smoke rising from a chimney. The artwork is created using fine-line etching, showcasing detailed textures. The color scheme is monochromatic, mainly using shades of brown to depict the timeless village scene.

artworks.title: Amiens Cathedral
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on beige wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand gothic cathedral facade. The drawing depicts the architectural details of a large cathedral, including stone carvings, arched doorways, decorative statues, a rose window, slender columns, pointed arches, and intricately decorated doorways. The facade is embellished with sculptural elements and ornate tracery. The illustration uses shading and linework to create depth and texture, capturing the essence of gothic design.

artworks.title: The Angler
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper, laid down on Phillips's album sheet
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tower on the right horizon surrounded by clouds in the sky. The horizon is low, and the foreground features two figures near a stream. One figure is seated, while the other is bending down. The scene includes a fallen tree trunk, rocks, trees, and flowing water. The artwork is created with fine etching lines for texture and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, using black ink and white to contrast elements in the scene.

artworks.title: The Round Tower
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a large mountain in the distance. The scene includes two figures on a path with a dog. The sky is filled with detailed clouds. The landscape is depicted in an engraving style with a monochromatic color palette of black and white. Trees frame the right side of the scene, and a cylindrical structure and other buildings are visible near water in the distance.

artworks.title: Birth Announcement for Marthe Mellerio
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in gray and brown on wove paper [proof, missing blue stone]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Nico and Bowie Cord
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a birth announcement card. The card features soft, muted tones and a minimalistic style. On the right side, there is delicate text declaring the birth of a girl named Marthe. The text is arranged in an elegant typeface, with a larger emphasis on the name. The background has a pale peach color with subtle textures. On the left side, there is a light illustration that is almost faded into the background, suggesting an abstract form or possibly a face. The date "le 29 Mars 1896" is inscribed at the bottom left corner in soft letters.

artworks.title: Sheet with Seven Etchings
artworks.medium: seven etchings printed on one sheet of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring detailed black and white sketches on a single sheet. The sheet displays various scenes and portraits. In the top left corner, there is a profile drawing of a woman's head with various hairstyles. Next to it, there is a chaotic scene of figures in a tussle. Adjacent is a sketch of an elderly man. Below the woman's portrait, there is an illustration of a cherubic figure standing on a globe. Alongside it, there is a sketch of a robed figure holding a tablet. Below the tussle, there is a scene of figures clashing in battle. Finally, in the bottom right, there is a sketch of figures in discussion. The sketches reflect a 17th-century Baroque style.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: tintype
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual faces forward and looks directly at the camera. They have a stern expression, prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and thin lips. The person's hair is neatly styled and dark. They wear a dark suit, a light-colored shirt, and a bow tie. The portrait is framed with an ornate, embossed frame featuring a star pattern. The background is textured and vintage-looking. No accessories are visible.

artworks.title: Vue d'une ruine près Chantilly (View of a Ruin near Chantilly)
artworks.artist: Mademoiselle Le Roy, after Louis Le Sueur
artworks.medium: chalk-manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural elements. Buildings can be seen in the far distance, integrated into hills. The style appears to be an etching or engraving with detailed lines. The color scheme is sepia and brown. In the foreground, there is water, foliage, and a partially ruined structure with a statue, surrounded by greenery. Trees and plants are present throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Vue d’une Laiterie près St. Maur-les-Paris (View of the Dairy near St. Maur-les-Paris)
artworks.artist: Mademoiselle Le Roy, after Louis Le Sueur
artworks.medium: chalk-manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a view from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high, marked by distant hills and scattered trees. A thatched-roof cottage is on the left, partly hidden by vegetation and a nearby wooden structure. It is an engraved artwork with detailed lines and shading defining textures of foliage, the cottage, and the terrain. The color palette is predominantly sepia and warm brown inks. In the distance, more trees and small structures are visible, creating a sense of depth. A group of people and livestock are walking along a path, adding life to the setting.

artworks.title: Vue d’une Ruine près St. Maur-les-Paris (View of a Ruin near St. Maur-les-Paris)
artworks.artist: Mademoiselle Le Roy, after Louis Le Sueur
artworks.medium: chalk-manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows ruins near St. Maur-les-Paris from a slightly elevated point of view. A tower with a clock and remnants of an ancient arch are visible against a high horizon. The composition features intricate line work, indicating an etching technique. Fine details depict the textures of the stone ruins, foliage, and thatched roofs. The color palette is warm monochrome, varying from sepia to sepia-orange. Two figures, barrels, and a chicken are near the viewer, surrounded by overgrown vegetation. In the distance, trees and additional ruins are framed by the sky.

artworks.title: Four Landscapes after Le Sueur
artworks.artist: Mademoiselle Le Roy, after Louis Le Sueur
artworks.medium: chalk-manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a rural village setting viewed from a slightly elevated point. The horizon line is positioned near the top of the image, beyond clusters of buildings and a large tree. Detailed etchings suggest a meticulous, illustrative style achieved through fine brushstrokes or engraving techniques, creating texture in the foliage, structures, and landscape. The scene is portrayed in a monochromatic sepia color palette, giving it a vintage or historic atmosphere. A pathway leads through rustic structures with figures engaged in daily activities, transitioning into natural countryside elements framed by the sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Cranes
artworks.medium: gum dichromate print
artworks.description: The image shows a row of large industrial structures near a body of water. The structures have cranes or large beams attached. The view is from ground level, with misty and atmospheric conditions obscuring the horizon and creating a mysterious feel. The image features soft brushstrokes or a grainy texture, a monochromatic color palette dominated by gray and black, and a pile of material near the viewer.

artworks.title: Das Bild der Düldung (Allegory of Tolerance)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an allegorical scene with classical and biblical references. The composition features a central gathering of figures, including divine and mythical beings, surrounded by various characters engaged in different activities. There are cherubs flying overhead, an individual holding a torch, and figures in seated and standing postures. The image is detailed, with intricate line work and shading emphasizing textures, costumes, architectural elements, and flora in the background.

artworks.title: Gideon Selects His Army at the River Jordan
artworks.artist: Melchior Küsel, after Johann Heinrich Schönfeld
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures by a river in a historical setting. The foreground displays several figures engaged in various activities, such as kneeling by the water and holding vessels. The background features architectural ruins, including a large, weathered wall with columns. There is also a diverse array of figures engaged in different actions, including some on horseback and others holding spears or standing.

artworks.title: The Personifications of the Arts and Sciences Pay Tribute to Carl Theodor von der Pfalz
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image is an intricate engraving featuring multiple figures. It depicts a person seated on the left holding a globe, dressed in a garment adorned with stars. Another figure stands next to her, dressed in classical armor and leaning against a pedestal with a medallion. Several putti are around them, one holding a cloth and another holding a laurel wreath. The background includes architectural elements like columns and a relief scene. More figures are present in the background, contributing to a sense of grandeur and ceremony.

artworks.title: Charity with Faith and Hope
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated with a child in her arms, accompanied by another child-like figure. The woman faces slightly to the left, looking down at the child she holds. Her features are soft, and she has curly hair framing her face. She is dressed elegantly, with flowing fabric. The child in her arms looks upwards, and the accompanying figure to the right holds a cross. The background features clouds and rays of sunlight, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Antonio Canova
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a head and shoulders portrait of a man. He is positioned slightly off-center with his body facing toward the left and his head turned to the right, gazing into the distance. He has well-defined facial features with prominent cheekbones and deep-set eyes. His hair is dark, curly, and styled away from his face. The man is wearing a formal outfit with a high-collared jacket, a vest, and an elegantly tied cravat. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain and light in color.

artworks.title: Four Dancing Children and Two Making Music
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing features cherubic figures in a festive outdoor setting. The scene shows cherubs playing in a wooded landscape. Two cherubs are dancing, with one being lifted by another, while others around them strike jubilant poses. One cherub is playing a pan flute-like instrument, leaning against a tree, and another cherub holds a tambourine-like instrument. The setting includes trees and an open sky, with detailed shading and textures. The composition is balanced, creating a harmonious and celebratory atmosphere typical of a festive gathering in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: The Last Judgement
artworks.artist: Léonard Gaultier, after Martino Rota, after Michelangelo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift in Memory of Robert L. Shalkop, Curator and Museum Director
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures, some nude, spread across various levels of clouds and earth. A glowing figure with a radiant halo is central to the image, with a ladder leading upwards towards them. The surrounding figures are depicted in dynamic poses, suggesting tension, struggle, or exaltation. The scene is divided into a heavenly upper section with clouds and a chaotic lower section. The detailed line work and composition highlight the fantastical nature of the drawing, invoking themes of morality, divine intervention, or cosmic events.

artworks.title: Dante and Virgil in Hell
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II, after Jacopo Ligozzi
artworks.medium: engraving mounted on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 20.3 × 27.5 cm (8 × 10 13/16 in.)
mount: 23 × 27.9 cm (9 1/16 × 11 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: The image shows two figures moving through a cave-like setting. The person on the right has long, flowing hair and a laurel wreath on their head. They face the other person, who has shorter hair and is gently guiding the first person with a hand on their shoulder. Both wear draped garments resembling classical robes. The background features rocky formations with shadows, creating a sense of depth. The ground appears uneven with scattered rocks, and there are logs or similar objects on the sides.

artworks.title: Travelers Resting in a Forest near a Hut
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, showing a scene with a high horizon. It features a series of tree canopies, a distant building or tower, and detailed lines and crosshatching characteristic of an engraving. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and grey. On the right side, two figures are seen interacting on a path surrounded by foliage and a large tree. Other smaller figures move along a winding path, passing by a rustic cottage with a thatched roof on the left. Trees, birds, and clouds are also depicted in the scene, with distant architectural forms suggesting an old, towering structure partially obscured by trees.

artworks.title: Peasant Interior with a Dancing Couple
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff, after Adriaen van Ostade
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Stephen and Claudine Ostrow
artworks.description: The image shows a gathering of people in a room. Most are seated while some are standing, engaging with each other. They are dressed in historic attire appropriate for a domestic or tavern setting, with details such as caps or hats. The room has wooden beams overhead, with various items like pots, pans, and tools on the walls. A cupboard with utensils is visible, and a dog is present near a dish on the floor. Light streams through a window with patterned panes in the background.
